body:
PR Summary by Qodo

Validate task text and IDs before loading the todo file ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Reject invalid task text and malformed IDs before loading the file, leaving it unchanged.
>• Report ID exhaustion as todo: no more ids instead of a write failure.
>• Expand CLI and subprocess tests for validation, unchanged files, and UTF-8 output.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD A["CLI arguments"] --> B{"Command"} -->|add| C["Text check"] --> E["Store load"] --> F{"ID available"} -->|yes| G["Item operation"] B -->|done/remove| D["ID parse"] --> E E -->|matched ID| G C -->|invalid| H["Error output"] D -->|invalid| H F -->|no| H E -->|unknown ID| H ```
High-Level Assessment

>Keep the shared CLI validators: they produce the required errors before file loading and can be reused by later commands. Argparse-level or store-level validation would complicate those error and ordering guarantees.
Files changed (4) +294 / -65

Enhancement (1) +67 / -14
cli.pyValidate text and IDs before store access +67/-14
>Validate text and IDs before store access > >
>• Adds reusable text and ID validators, applying them to add and done/remove before loading the file. Separates malformed IDs from well-formed missing IDs and reports exhausted IDs with 'todo: no more ids'.
>
> >todo/cli.py
Tests (1) +201 / -51
test_cli.pyCover strict IDs, clean text, and ID exhaustion +201/-51
>Cover strict IDs, clean text, and ID exhaustion > >
>• Moves malformed-ID cases to bad-ID expectations while preserving unknown-item coverage and file-unchanged checks. Adds text-validation, one-line listing, real non-UTF-8 argv, strict-UTF-8 output, and ID-exhaustion tests.
>
> >tests/test_cli.py
Documentation (2) +26 / -0
DISPOSITIONS.mdRecord no cold-review findings +3/-0
>Record no cold-review findings > >
>• Adds the M4 disposition table with no findings to resolve.
>
> >reviews/cold/M4/DISPOSITIONS.md
round-1.mdDocument M4 cold-review coverage +23/-0
>Document M4 cold-review coverage > >
>• Records the reviewed criteria, test evidence, scope assessment, and absence of findings.
>
> >reviews/cold/M4/round-1.md

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
